questions.question_text: The reception team had to borrow copy paper from another floor after we ______ it before noon.

options.A: run by

questions.explanation_zh: run out of 表示用品用盡；句中交代紙張耗盡，run into 只是碰到。

questions.question_text: The front desk may ______ visitor badges if the courier is delayed again this morning.

options.A: run into

questions.explanation_zh: may 後接原形；語意是名牌快耗盡，所以用 run out of，不是 run into。

questions.question_text: Before the auditors arrive, Ms. Wu will ______ a temporary workspace in the small meeting room.

options.A: set up

questions.explanation_zh: set up 表示安排或設立臨時空間；set aside 是保留，不合語境。

questions.question_text: The operations assistant was asked to ______ a video call for the branch managers before 3 p.m.

options.A: set back

questions.explanation_zh: 此處要安排視訊會議，固定用 set up；set aside 只有保留之意。

questions.question_text: If Mr. Ito has a few minutes after lunch, he can ______ our office to sign the delivery form.

options.A: drop off

questions.explanation_zh: drop by 表示順道拜訪；drop off 多指送達或下降，不是臨時來訪。

questions.question_text: Our supplier plans to ______ the office this afternoon because the sample boxes need approval today.

options.A: drop by

questions.explanation_zh: 語境是供應商順道來辦公室，因此用 drop by；drop off 偏向送下貨。

questions.question_text: Please ______ the revised seating chart before the visitors arrive at reception.

options.A: look into

questions.explanation_zh: look over 表示快速查看文件；look into 是調查，與接待前檢查不符。

questions.question_text: The director asked me to ______ the reimbursement list once more before finance receives it.

options.A: look after

questions.explanation_zh: 此處是再審閱名單，所以用 look over；look around 只表示四處查看。

questions.question_text: We may ______ a scheduling problem if the training room is still occupied at noon.

options.A: run through

questions.explanation_zh: run into 可指遭遇問題；run out of 是耗盡，和會議室衝突不符。

questions.question_text: The office move could ______ delays unless the IT team finishes the network check tonight.

options.A: run by

questions.explanation_zh: 句意是搬遷可能遭遇延誤，因此用 run into；run through 不表示碰到障礙。

questions.question_text: Please ______ the guest badges from reception before escorting the clients upstairs.

options.A: pick up

questions.explanation_zh: pick up 表示拿取物件；hand in 是提交，和去櫃檯領取相反。

questions.question_text: Ms. Lin will ______ the signed contract from the courier desk after the afternoon briefing.

options.A: take over

questions.explanation_zh: 此處是到櫃檯領取文件，所以用 pick up；take over 是接管，語意不同。

questions.question_text: The receptionist will ______ parking passes to all conference guests at the lobby desk.

options.A: give over

questions.explanation_zh: give out 在此表示分發；give away 偏向白送或洩露，不是正式派發。

questions.question_text: Please ______ the updated evacuation cards before the safety drill begins on Friday.

options.A: give back

questions.explanation_zh: 安全演練前要分發卡片，因此用 give out；give back 是歸還，不合句意。

questions.question_text: The office manager expected the printer cartridges to last through Friday. However, two departments printed extra presentation packets this morning. By noon, we had ______ toner and had to delay the copies for the client visit.

options.A: run through

questions.explanation_zh: 前文說大量加印導致碳粉耗盡，所以用 run out of；run into 不表用完。

questions.question_text: The regional managers were told at 9 a.m. that the original meeting link had failed. To keep the review on schedule, the assistant quickly ______ a new video conference and emailed the access code to everyone.

options.A: set aside

questions.explanation_zh: 語境要臨時安排新會議，因此用 set up；set aside 只是擱置保留。

questions.question_text: The purchasing director cannot stay for the full site tour because another meeting was moved forward. She said she would ______ our office after lunch, sign the samples, and then head to the airport.

options.A: drop off

questions.explanation_zh: 前後文表示短暫順道到訪，所以用 drop by；drop off 只像送人或送貨。

questions.question_text: The assistant finished revising the visitor schedule, but the director has not approved it yet. Before the guests arrive, he wants to ______ the final version for any timing conflicts.

options.A: look for

questions.explanation_zh: 此處是快速審閱最終版本，所以用 look over；look into 偏向深入調查。

questions.question_text: The delivery route looked simple on paper, yet a road closure was announced just before departure. As a result, the driver may ______ traffic delays and miss the first appointment.

options.A: run through

questions.explanation_zh: 前文指出道路封閉，會遭遇延誤，所以用 run into；run out of 是耗盡。

questions.question_text: The reception desk called to say the client welcome packets had arrived early. Since the sales team is still in a cross-department briefing, could you ______ the packets and place them in the meeting room?

options.A: pick over

questions.explanation_zh: 語境是去櫃檯取回資料，固定用 pick up；pick out 是挑選特定對象，pick over 是逐件翻揀，pick off 是逐一除去。
